chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Al-Hasan Al-Attar, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'He will not attain my intercession, the one who belittles his prayer, and he will not return to me at the Fountain, no, by Allah. He will not attain my intercession, the one who drinks the intoxicant, and he will not return to me at the Fountain, no, by Allah.'
ai.seo_question: Who is excluded from the Prophet's intercession and drinking from his Fountain?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, the Prophet (peace be upon him) links the neglect of Salah and the consumption of Khamr (intoxicants) as dual barriers to attaining his intercession (Shafa'ah) and drinking from his Fountain (Al-Hawd). This emphasizes that ritual prayer is the pillar of faith, while intoxicants corrupt the intellect, both of which are essential for the believer's ultimate success in the Hereafter according to Shia tradition.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Hassan Al Ataar, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘He will not attain my<sup>saww</sup> intercession, the one who belittles with his Prayer, and he would not return to me<sup>saww</sup> at the Fountain, no, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He would not attain my<sup>saww</sup> intercession, the one who drinks the intoxicant, and he would not return to me<sup>saww</sup> at the Fountain, no, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!’
en.sarwar: 19. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Hassan al-‘Attar from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘

My intercession will not apply to those who take their Salat (prayer) lightly and he will not be able to reach before me on the pond. No, by Allah my intercession will not apply to those who drink intoxicating liquor and will not be able to come to me on the pond, no, by Allah (it will not happen).”’
